flows.title: Desktop app access
flows.desc: One shared setup. macOS approvals appear only when needed.

steps.title: Enable app access
steps.copy: Let msgblast send messages and read replies in your apps.
steps.body:
Control appsAccessibility
Read app screensScreen Recording
Enable access
Not now

You approve each request in macOS.
steps.caption: Bundled driver; no separate installation step.

steps.title: Allow app control
steps.copy: Turn on the requested msgblast entry in System Settings.
steps.body:
Privacy & SecurityAccessibility
msgblastOff → On
Open System Settings
Check again

Return here after enabling access.
steps.caption: Illustrative handoff. Exact owner and displayed name require bundled-build verification.

steps.title: Allow screen access
steps.copy: Allow msgblast to read replies from app screens.
steps.body:
Privacy & SecurityScreen Recording
msgblastOff → On
Open System Settings
Check again

Reopen the helper if macOS asks you to.
steps.caption: Separate approval. Full Disk Access does not grant this.

steps.title: Check your apps
steps.copy: Access is checked separately from app readiness.
steps.body:
App controlAllowed
Screen accessAllowed
MuseReady · Side chats
Grok BotReady
WabiOpen and sign in
Continue with ready apps
Open Wabi
steps.caption: Check connections without sending a test message.

flows.foot: Design intent: msgblast branding throughout. Packaging alone does not prove a single TCC entry. Preserve separate underlying grant checks; show helper-specific guidance if the signed build requires it.

flows.title: Messages
flows.desc: Separate permissions for history, sending, and optional contact lookup.

steps.title: Connect Messages
steps.copy: Enable the parts you want. You can skip this setup.
steps.body:
Read historyFull Disk Access
Send messagesAutomation
Find peopleContacts · Optional
Set up Messages
Not now
steps.caption: Messages permissions are independent of desktop app access.

steps.title: Allow history access
steps.copy: Enable msgblast in Full Disk Access.
steps.body:
Privacy & SecurityFull Disk Access
msgblastOff → On
Open System Settings
Check again

Messages history stays read-only.
steps.caption: Illustrative System Settings handoff. Read access never edits Messages’ database.

steps.title: Allow sending
steps.copy: macOS asks before msgblast can control Messages.
steps.body:
msgblast wants to control Messages
Allow
Don’t Allow

Contacts is a separate, optional request when finding people.
steps.caption: Automation approval is not evidence of message delivery. Contacts denial must remain recoverable.

steps.title: Review found agents
steps.copy: Choose the existing chats to add.
steps.body:
☑ FoExample fixture
☑ PokeExample fixture
☐ InstinctExample fixture
Add selected
Skip

Optional: Allow Contacts to show names and suggestions.
steps.caption: Synthetic agent names for review. Return to the connection list.

flows.foot: No live messages are sent during permission setup. Contact access is optional; its macOS consent is a separate grant, never bundled with Automation.

flows.title: Optional Contacts access
flows.desc: Ask only when the user wants names and people suggestions.

steps.title: Find people more easily
steps.copy: Use contact names and suggestions when connecting Messages.
steps.body:
Contact lookupOptional
Messages sendingIndependent permission
Allow Contacts
Not now
steps.caption: Explain the benefit before requesting OS access.

steps.title: Allow contact access?
steps.copy: msgblast would like access to your contacts.
steps.body:
Find names and suggest peopleContacts
Allow
Don’t Allow

The exact macOS dialog and access choices depend on OS version.
steps.caption: Illustrative macOS consent. Do not imply this also enables Messages sending.

steps.title: Continue without Contacts
steps.copy: You can still use your other connections.
steps.body:
ContactsNot enabled
Other ready connectionsAvailable
Continue
Manage in Settings
steps.caption: Keep contact lookup optional. Check actual grant state before using Contacts.

flows.foot: Request Contacts just in time, independently of app control, screen recording, Messages history, and sending. Handle denied or limited access according to the OS response.

flows.title: CLIs
flows.desc: A separate local-tool flow. No Messages permissions or chat discovery.

steps.title: Connect CLIs
steps.copy: Use optional CLI conversations on this Mac.
steps.body:
Codex CLICheck installation
Claude CodeCheck installation
OpenClawSetup guide
HermesSetup guide
Check tools
Not now
steps.caption: Setup guides are navigation, not ready connections.

steps.title: Finish CLI setup
steps.copy: Install or sign in using the tool’s own setup.
steps.body:
InstallationFound
Local accountSign in needed
WorkspaceChoose folder

Check again
steps.caption: Each integration keeps its own authentication and workspace identity.

steps.title: Review CLIs
steps.copy: Add the tools that passed their checks.
steps.body:
Codex CLIReady
Claude CodeSign in
OpenClawSetup needed

steps.caption: Only configured, chat-ready integrations count toward Continue.

flows.foot: A missing executable, setup guide, or account check failure must not be silently marked ready. Setup checks do not make paid model requests.

flows.title: Recovery & deferred setup
flows.desc: Keep a way forward without showing every error as another wizard page.

steps.title: Access still needed
steps.copy: Finish enabling access, or set up later.
steps.body:
App controlAllowed
Screen accessOff
Open System Settings
Check again
Continue with other connections
steps.caption: Do not repeat permission prompts in a loop. Recheck actual grants.

steps.title: Finish connecting Wabi
steps.copy: Open the app and sign in to your account.
steps.body:
InstalledFound
App stateOpen and sign in
Open Wabi
Check connection
Set up later
steps.caption: Missing apps instead show an install/open action. No false Ready status.

steps.title: Finish access setup
steps.copy: The connection helper needs attention.
steps.body:
Helper statusSetup required
Retry setup
Troubleshoot
Continue with other connections

If macOS requests it, reopen the helper and check access again.
steps.caption: Unknown stays unknown. Successful setup exit alone does not prove grants.

flows.foot: If zero connections are ready, allow leaving setup for a non-chat home with clear setup actions. Do not label an empty selection as ready to chat.
